affinity.notes: Scales, natural spines, leather, and metal remain dominant; the small glow is incidental.

anatomy.notes: Head, limbs, tail, and weapon grip are coherent.

archetype.notes: Ranged skirmisher communicates the intended lure-ambush hunter duty.

counterplay.notes: The long polearm and mobile stance clearly communicate reach, directional threat, and a skirmishing profile.

finish.notes: Scales, armor, and restrained glow feel materially grounded.

framing.notes: Three-quarter full-body stance clearly presents weapon and silhouette.

identity.notes: Amphibious reptilian hunter identifies the Abyssal Hunter form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
